ai_summary: ABINFRABUILD Limited announced its 16th Annual General Meeting (AGM) will be held virtually on September 28, 2026. The company will close its share transfer books from September 22-28, 2026, for the proposed dividend and AGM, with a critical record date of September 21, 2026, for dividend eligibility. This is a standard regulatory filing with no material red flags, primarily impacting shareholders who need to be aware of the dividend record date.
